subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw support PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession as a permanent after-compaction plugin contract, or keep session rotation internal to core and owner-plugin lifecycle code?
rationale: The method adds plugin-visible session-reset authority and compatibility expectations; code review can validate mechanics but cannot decide the supported long-term plugin contract.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session-only API after removing ownerless local queues and require focused compatibility tests plus real lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Remove the public hook-context method and implement any required compaction recovery through a core or owner-plugin policy seam.

options.title: Pause and redesign
options.body: Split the runtime bug investigation from the plugin API proposal until lifecycle ownership and supported hook surfaces are explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only API after removing ownerless local queues and require focused compatibility tests plus real lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to session-reset behavior, Codex compaction, and harness runtime direction. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50096?utm_source=openai))
